description: This file defines an abstract controller class for viewing employee information within the OrangeHRM system. It manages permissions, handles rendering of employee data, and interacts with services and traits to facilitate role and configuration management.

classes.name: BaseViewEmployeeController
classes.description: An abstract controller facilitating employee data viewing, permissions management, and rendering integration within the OrangeHRM framework.

methods.name: getPimLeftMenuService
methods.description: Returns an instance of PIMLeftMenuService, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Handles the rendering of the employee view, setting properties for tabs, allowed file types, and maximum file size based on configuration and employee data.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to specify data groups for permission checks.

methods.name: isCapable
methods.description: Determines if the current user has capability to view the specified employee data based on permissions and access rights.

methods.name: setPermissionsForEmployee
methods.description: Sets permission data for a specific employee into the context for use elsewhere.

methods.name: isEmployeeAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the employee identified by employee number is accessible by the current user.
